objective: Add an optional Pink Book post to Spot check-in, move the Pink Book section below attribution, and let authors delete their own Pink Book posts after checkout.
userOutcome: Members can write a Pink Book post while checking in and later remove their own post without remaining checked in.
audience: Authenticated cruush members using Spot details.
successCriteria: The signed-out-of-check-in state includes an optional Pink Book text input inside the check-in card.
Submitting a check-in sends the optional post through the existing check-in endpoint.
The Pink Book and Who's Here section appears below the Spot source attribution.
Checked-out members see only their own Pink Book posts and can delete them; other members' posts remain hidden until check-in.
Affected user-visible Spot copy calls the feature Pink Book.
mustPreserve: Preserve Who's Here visibility without check-in.
Preserve active check-in requirements for reading other members' Pink Book posts and creating later posts.
Preserve existing Spot styling, vibes, amenities, timers, ratings, attribution, moderation, and location gates.
nonGoals: Do not redesign adjacent Spot content or map behavior.
Do not expose other members' Pink Book posts without an active check-in.
Do not run tests or deploy; Julien will test this release slice.

assumptions.statement: People outside an active check-in may access only their own Pink Book posts for deletion.
assumptions.impact: The existing Pink Book endpoint returns all visible posts while checked in and only the requesting author's posts otherwise.

nextVisibleMilestone: Commit the Pink Book check-in and post-deletion slice for Julien's mobile test.
